name: ORGABIO
recent: Orgabio 于 2026 年 9 月宣布以 RM11.26 million 现金收购位于 Semenyih 的一幅永久地契工业地及建筑物，用于仓库发展。公司将于 2026 年 11 月 27 日召开第八届常年股东大会，并寻求股东批准更新现有经常性关联交易授权。近期亦有多名董事及大股东申报股权变动。
notable: 全资子公司 Orgabio Manufacturing Sdn. Bhd. 与 Chung Lian Fatt 签署买卖协议，以 RM11.26 million 现金收购 Semenyih 一幅约 5,263 平方米的永久地契土地及单层建筑物，用于仓库发展。
以进行收益或交易性质的经常性关联交易，并将在第八届常年股东大会寻求批准。
公司将于 2026 年 11 月 27 日召开第八届常年股东大会。
risks: 多名董事及大股东于 2025 年 9 月底至 10 月初申报在公开市场买卖公司股份。

news.title: Orgabio to buy Semenyih industrial property for RM11.26m for warehousing

recent_en: Orgabio announced in September 2026 the acquisition of a freehold industrial land and building in Semenyih for RM11.26 million cash, intended for warehouse development. Several directors and substantial shareholders have also reported changes in their shareholdings recently.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Orgabio Manufacturing Sdn. Bhd. signed an SPA with Chung Lian Fatt to acquire a freehold land of approximately 5,263 sq m with a single-storey building in Semenyih for RM11.26 million cash, for warehouse development.
The company proposes to renew the existing shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions of a revenue or trading nature, to be tabled at the 8th AGM.
risks_en: Several directors and substantial shareholders reported dealings in the company's shares in the open market in late September to early October 2025.
